description: A metal wire dish rack sits on a green-covered table, and a short stack of colorful plastic cups is beside it. The right hand reaches in from the right, grips the stacked cups as a right-hand object, lifts them over the rack, then tilts and separates them one by one—setting a blue cup into the rack first, then placing the green and yellow cups upright beside it, and finally sliding the red cup into the right side of the rack before releasing.
